cost_policy.new_authoring: record observable wall windows separately; parallel windows are not additive latency
cost_policy.final_policy: one-use namespace; no selection or hyperparameter changes after frozen fit
cost_policy.warmup: shared cold optimizer/SVD initialization retained in total process wall
cost_policy.standalone: common feature preparation added back to each arm as a lower bound, without double counting in actual campaign total

primary_contrasts: representation: same_generator minus ordinary_tanh and drop_value_risk, candidate and dev-selected MSE; legacy/empirical and exposure/bounded_floor; paired over all five seeds by task and split

representation: bounded_floor minus empirical at same pool/bank/link; exposure minus legacy at same bank/scaler/link; clip_unit minus identity for first_passage only; candidate clip effect holds weights fixed, selected representation effects may include different dev fallback decisions

control: hard review minus bounded-class optimum plus bounded optimum minus BP on training reward; independent final comparison at identical interval and L; decomposition uses non-fallback candidate, never selected pi=0 outside the bounded class
clock: same-trajectory coarse versus 4-way refinement; exact terminal/cumulative quantities, expected tolerance 1e-9 for event_mask and continuous_write

readout: direct versus actual local BP at identical ridge/normalization and objective gap <=1e-8; report all nonconverged cases and all costs; same-quality cost screen uses per-case max(1e-6,.01*zero_dev_MSE), separately from training optimality

profiled: joint BP versus variable-projection BP versus semantic-initialized variable-projection BP; common 51-parameter union, same fixed checkpoint grid, two named task families; same-quality screen max(1e-6,.01*incumbent_dev_MSE)
claim_limits: No multimodal foundation-model or Transformer replacement claim
No hardware energy, GPU, biological-spiking or full-network no-BP claim
Fixed review MDP is not continuous-observation QVI
Continuous write is a new finite held process, not unchanged event writing
Normalization floor changes raw-coordinate regularization; output projection is post-fit processing
Any exhausted training budget remains unproven convergence
Five paired seeds are descriptive evidence, not population-scale certainty
N256, C2 and HPCA qualification remains separately owned and unchanged
summary_rule: All five paired seed effects, arithmetic mean, observed min/max; no significance or confidence interpretation of the range
